principle: When a work item has a user-facing interface, UI design is owned; a separate pre-implementation visual artifact is required only when risk, collaboration cost, or visual sensitivity justifies it.

delivery_modes.purpose: Record explicitly that the work item has no user-facing interface and therefore needs no UI artifact.
Move quickly on low-risk or exploratory UI through an executable implementation.
Confirm important layout, states, and interaction direction before full implementation.
Use an approved design source for brand-sensitive, high-rework-cost, or multi-party delivery.

tool_policy.selection_rule: Choose the lightest tool that can produce the required evidence for the selected delivery mode.

selection_scope: Record the selected mode on the Work Item. For interface work, preserve the rationale and evidence in a project-owned UI brief; a later project profile may define a default.
